name: InfiniteBench
intro: InfiniteBench是首个平均数据长度超过10万标记的大语言模型（LLM）基准。它涵盖了合成与真实世界的任务，涉及多个领域，并同时支持英文和中文。该基准测试中的任务旨在要求模型对上下文中的长距离依赖关系有深入的理解，仅仅从上下文中检索有限的段落不足以完成这些任务。
build_method: 混合, 自动生成, 专家构建
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 代码生成, 数学问题, 文本摘要
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Code Generation, Math Problems, Text Summarization
intro_en: InfiniteBench is the first large language model (LLM) benchmark with an average data length exceeding 100,000 tokens. It covers both synthetic and real-world tasks across multiple domains and supports both English and Chinese. The tasks in this benchmark require models to deeply understand long-range dependencies in the context; retrieving only limited paragraphs from the context is insufficient to complete these tasks.
scale_en: 3,946 examples, 12 tasks, approximately 200,000 tokens on average

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.13718. InfiniteBench contains 12 tasks across retrieval, code, math, novels, and dialogue, with 3,946 examples and average context length beyond 100K tokens. The paper separates realistic long-context tasks from synthetic contexts. For realistic tasks, novels are sourced from websites and manually filtered, then key entities are replaced to create fake novels; annotators create summarization, open QA, and multiple-choice tasks requiring aggregation or filtering over the full novel. Dialogue tasks use cleaned movie and drama scripts with character masking and padding for short scripts. Code.Debug uses filtered PyPI repositories transformed into single long files with deliberate bugs inserted by authors. Synthetic retrieval, code, and math tasks probe location, information resolution, state preservation, and sequential processing. Evaluation uses task-specific metrics such as ROUGE-L-Sum and accuracy.
